concept: Yacht charter in the Gulf; fleet, itinerary builder and quote.

shots.title: Experiences
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Experiences, cinematic travel photography. Top-left: Jumping off the swim platform. Top-right: Seafood lunch on deck. Bottom-left: Jet skiing. Bottom-right: Sunset on the flybridge. Every person in the picture is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all vary) so no face is repeated; faces may be turned away or out of frame. Overall look: glossy marine photography, turquoise water, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, teak, turquoise. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
